mode: CONFIRMATORY (pre-registered before any AF1 result was read)
research_question: When misspecifying the observation family of attribute data X degrades recovery of the shared latent structure Z, how much of that degradation does automatic per-column family selection prevent?
lineage: E-consistent per-column (experimental prototype; not adoptable for the manuscript)
half_factor: adopted equations, no extra 1/2 (fixed lineage via DualExpFamLSMMasked)

masks.rule: all methods and both Auto stages see the same train mask; test pairs are never in any train mask

auto_settings.score: Q_l(m) = mean over the L fixed E-step samples of sum_i log p_m(x_il | f_lm^T z_i), full normaliser, f_lm optimised per candidate

methods.primary_auto_start_rationale: The Poisson start begins at the Wrong assignment, so any recovery is attributable to the selector and not to the initial assignment.

seeds.oracle_wrong_seed: series model seed (identical to E1 Part A / B)
seeds.note: the two series and the two starts reuse the same data; they are NOT independent datasets

primary_metric: Procrustes RMSE(Z) of the joint posterior mode (E1 'mode', Z0 = last)
replicate_aggregation: per replicate and regime, the contrast is the mean over the seed series in which both fits and both modes are OK; series results are also reported separately

interval.type: percentile bootstrap of the mean of replicate-level contrasts

secondary_metrics: number of gate-decided and score-decided columns
held-out Y mean log score and AUC
missing_and_failure_rule: FAILED fits and non-OK modes are kept, never retried or imputed. A contrast is computed only where both members are OK; the number excluded is reported next to every summary together with the failure rate.
technical_stop_conditions: a test pair inside any train mask
data or mask hash differing between methods of a cell
Auto refit train mask differing from the cell's train mask
protocol.json on disk differing from this protocol
warnings_not_stops: candidate optimiser non-convergence (recorded; the selection stands)
